// Stands in for "dart test" / "flutter test" in the tests of
// `test_gates timezones`. Kept as .txt so that it is not analyzed or
// formatted with the package; the tests copy it into a temporary directory
// and run it there.
//
// Usage: dart fake_zone_test.dart <test file>...
//
// Every run appends "TZ=<zone> <arguments>" to "zones.log". The run fails
// (exit 1, with a line that names the zone) when the zone is listed in
// "fail-in", one name per line.
import 'dart:io';

List<String> listed(String name) =>
    File(name).existsSync() ? File(name).readAsLinesSync() : const [];

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments) async {
  final zone = Platform.environment['TZ'];
  File('zones.log').writeAsStringSync(
    'TZ=$zone ${arguments.join(' ')}\n',
    mode: FileMode.append,
  );
  if (listed('fail-in').contains(zone)) {
    stdout.writeln('Expected: <31>\n  Actual: <1> in $zone');
    exitCode = 1;
  }
}
